description: This Java source file defines the class FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException, a specific type of runtime exception used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It indicates that a requested feature definition on a Thing either does not exist or the requester lacks sufficient permissions. The class includes construction methods, a builder pattern, and metadata annotations, and fits into a larger exception handling scheme for the Ditto project.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the feature definition is not accessible, either because it does not exist or due to insufficient permissions. It includes static factory methods and a builder for creating instances, along with annotations indicating immutability and exception parsing capability.
